new_commodity_proposals.evidence: Not already priced under another spelling: the only flour id in the estate is `flour`, whose vocabulary name is All-Purpose Flour, and no commodity, recipe-commodity or board row names a whole-grain wheat flour. It is a genuine form flip rather than a synonym: whole wheat is a separate bag at a higher per-lb price and a different gram weight per cup (about 120 g against 125 g for AP), so bridging it onto `flour` would publish both a wrong price and a wrong weight.

registrar_rulings.reason: Not priced anywhere under another spelling: the live feed contains no 'whole wheat' string at all, and the only flour ids in the estate are flour (All-Purpose, priced $0.3392/lb Sam's Club), almond-flour (a different food), and the recipe alias all-purpose-flour -> flour. Decisively, the existing flour commodity EXCLUDES 'whole\s+wheat' (commodities.json line 10882), so the estate already treats whole wheat as a different purchase and bridging it onto flour would price the wrong bag at a wrong per-lb and a wrong g/cup. Mint whole-wheat-flour as a recipe-only id (recipe-board baseline + recipe-commodities.json) unless Brad promotes it to the weekly worklist. Prescription: include must require the contiguous phrase 'whole\s+wheat\s+flour' (also 'whole[\s-]*grain\s+(wheat\s+)?flour', 'white\s+whole\s+wheat\s+flour'); exclude whole-wheat BREAD/PASTA/TORTILLA/PANCAKE-MIX products plus the full household/pet/baby boilerplate cloned from flour's ~80-pattern list, and 'bread\s+flour', 'self[\s-]*rising', '\bmix\b'. Follow-up edits for the caller: add allowlist pairs (whole-wheat-flour, flour, 'different form: whole-grain vs refined AP, separate bags at different per-lb') and (whole-wheat-flour, almond-flour, 'different food') to commodity-dupe-allowlist.json in the same change, so the daily dupe audit's substring sweep never re-flags a pair already adjudicated here.
